معاني القرآن بكلام شيخ الإسلام ابن تيمية: The meanings of the Quran in the words of Shaykh al-Islam Ibn Taymiyya and his student Imam Ibn al-Qayyim
تفسير الإمامين ابن تيمية وابن القيم من أ: The tafsir of the two imams Ibn Taymiyya and Ibn al-Qayyim is among the most valuable writings on understanding the Quran, yet it was never written as a standalone tafsir; it is scattered across dozens of books, fatwas and treatises. Anyone seeking their words on a single verse must leaf through many volumes, most of which are available only as unsearchable scans. So we set out to gather this heritage in one place, arranged by verse, easy to search, and free for everyone.
مختصر لكل آية بكلامهما:: A summary for every verse in their own words:
لكل إمام على حدة، منقول بنصه دون تصرف، م: for each imam separately, quoted verbatim without alteration, with a reference to the book, volume and page.
for those who want to go deeper and study the finer points.
أقوال الصحابة والتابعين والمفسرين التي أ: sayings of the Companions, Successors and exegetes that they cited, with the imam's position on each: reported it, approved it, rejected it, cited it as evidence, or preferred another view.
ما ردّاه من أقوال المخالفين في تفسير الآ: views of opponents on the verse's interpretation that they refuted.
يمكن تثبيت الموقع على الهاتف كتطبيق، وال: the site can be installed on your phone as an app, and the surahs you have opened work without internet.
يقوم العمل على منهجية علمية منضبطة تجمع: The work follows a disciplined scholarly methodology that combines a comprehensive survey of the sources, automated textual verification, multi-stage scholarly review, and statistical tools for controlling and measuring quality.

'Abd al-'Aziz ibn Muhammad al-Khalifa), Madarij al-Salikin bayna Manazil Iyyaka Na'budu wa-Iyyaka Nasta'in, Zad al-Ma'ad fi Hady Khayr al-'Ibad, Bada'i' al-Fawa'id.
استقراء شامل لمؤلفات الإمامين لحصر كل مو: a comprehensive survey of the two imams' works to locate every passage in which they discuss a verse of the Noble Qur'an, with each passage then linked to its verse and ordered by the surahs of the Mushaf.
يُنتقى للمختصر ما كان من كلام الإمام نفس: the summary takes only the imam's own words that explain the meaning of the verse and are complete in themselves; what he reports from others is separated and shown on its own, with his position on it.
يُطابَق كل نص منشور مع أصله في الكتاب مط: every published text is matched automatically, letter by letter, against its source in the book, and this check is repeated with every new release.
مراجعة علمية متعددة المراحل تشمل موضع ال: a multi-stage scholarly review covering each text's placement under its verse, its attribution to its speaker and the completeness of its meaning, together with risk-based review in which the texts most likely to contain errors are identified automatically and reviewed in full.
تُسحب عينات عشوائية من النصوص وتُراجع مر: random samples of texts are drawn and given a complete, independent review to measure the level of accuracy and direct review effort where it is needed.

Muhammad al-Sayyid al-Julaynd), Tafsir Shaykh al-Islam Ibn Taymiyya (comp. Iyad ibn 'Abd al-Latif al-Qaysi), Bada'i' al-Tafsir al-Jami' li-ma Fassarahu al-Imam Ibn Qayyim al-Jawziyya (comp. Yusri al-Sayyid Muhammad), Tafsir al-Qur'an al-Karim by Ibn al-Qayyim (Dar wa-Maktabat al-Hilal); anything missed was added by returning to its place in the original book.
تُراجع تصويبات القراء وتُدرج في الإصدارا: readers' corrections are reviewed and incorporated into subsequent releases, and every update is documented on the updates page.
المعنى الإجمالي لكل آية:: The overall meaning of every verse:
من «التفسير الميسر»، تمهيدًا لفهم الآية: from al-Tafsir al-Muyassar, as a first step to understanding the verse before going deeper into the words of the two shaykhs.
أُضيف إلى كل آية معناها الإجمالي من «الت: Every verse is accompanied by its overall meaning from al-Tafsir al-Muyassar (King Fahd Glorious Qur'an Printing Complex), to set out the general sense before going deeper into the words of the two imams, since their discussion may address one aspect of a verse rather than all of it. It is shown in a separate box, reproduced unchanged from the Encyclopedia of the Noble Qur'an, QuranEnc.com, with its version number, to keep it distinct from the imams' words.
جميع كتب الإمامين المتاحة رقميًا، ومنها: all the digitally available books of the two imams, including Majmu' al-Fatawa, Dar' al-Ta'arud, Madarij al-Salikin, Zad al-Ma'ad and Bada'i' al-Fawa'id, along with Ibn Taymiyya's Tafsir Ayat Ashkalat edited by 'Abd al-'Aziz al-Khalifa.
حُصرت كل فقرة يذكر فيها أحد الإمامين آية: every paragraph in which either imam mentions a verse of the Quran was identified and linked to its verse.
اختيرت للمختصر الجمل التي فيها شرح معنى: for the summary, sentences that explain the meaning of the verse were chosen, not passing citations.
كل جملة في الموقع طوبقت آليًا حرفًا بحرف: every sentence on the site was automatically matched letter by letter against the book's text, so nothing is attributed to the two imams by paraphrase.
فُصل كلام الإمام عن الأقوال التي يحكيها: the imam's own words were separated from the views he reports from others, so that an opponent's view he refutes is not attributed to him.
قوبل العمل بالجموع المطبوعة السابقة، وهي: the work was checked against earlier printed compilations — Daqa'iq al-Tafsir by al-Julaynd, Bada'i' al-Tafsir by Yusri al-Sayyid Muhammad, and Tafsir Shaykh al-Islam by Iyad al-Qaysi — and what had been missed was added.
من مشروع «تنزيل» (tanzil.net)، ونصوص الك: from the Tanzil project (tanzil.net); book texts are from al-Maktaba al-Shamila as preserved by the OpenITI corpus, with the reference to the edition given under each text.
سبقتنا جهود مشكورة في جمع تفسير كل إمام: Commendable efforts preceded us in compiling each imam's tafsir separately in printed volumes. This work adds to them:
the words of both imams side by side on every verse.
a concise layer in their own words before the full texts.
distinguished from their own words, together with their position on them.
البحث الشامل والإتاحة المجانية على كل جه: comprehensive search and free access on every device.
ولا يغني هذا العمل عن الرجوع إلى الكتب ا: This work is no substitute for returning to the original critically edited books; it is a gateway to them.

شيخ الإسلام تقي الدين أبو العباس أحمد بن: Shaykh al-Islam Taqi al-Din Abu al-'Abbas Ahmad ibn 'Abd al-Halim ibn 'Abd al-Salam al-Harrani (661–728 AH)
وُلد بحرّان، وانتقل به أهله صغيرًا إلى د: Born in Harran, his family moved with him to Damascus when he was young, where he grew up and excelled in tafsir, hadith, fiqh, usul and creed, until he was called Shaykh al-Islam. He strove with his tongue, pen and sword, was tried and imprisoned many times, and died in detention in the Citadel of Damascus.
لم يصنّف تفسيرًا كاملًا للقرآن، وإنما فس: He did not write a complete tafsir of the Quran; he explained verses throughout his books, fatwas and treatises. His method was to explain the Quran by the Quran, then by the Sunna, then by the sayings of the Companions and Successors, with attention to the Arabic language and rejection of interpretations contrary to it — principles he laid down in his Introduction to the Principles of Tafsir.
«درء تعارض العقل والنقل»، «منهاج السنة ا: Dar' Ta'arud al-'Aql wa-l-Naql, Minhaj al-Sunna al-Nabawiyya
الإمام شمس الدين أبو عبد الله محمد بن أب: Imam Shams al-Din Abu 'Abd Allah Muhammad ibn Abi Bakr ibn Ayyub al-Zur'i al-Dimashqi (691–751 AH)
عُرف بابن قيّم الجوزية لأن أباه كان قيّم: He was known as Ibn Qayyim al-Jawziyya because his father was the superintendent (qayyim) of the Jawziyya school in Damascus. He accompanied Shaykh al-Islam Ibn Taymiyya from 712 AH until his death, took his knowledge and method from him, was imprisoned with him in the Citadel, and became one of the foremost to spread and refine his teaching.
امتاز بحسن العرض وعمق النظر في أسرار الأ: He was distinguished by clear presentation and deep insight into the secrets of words, the wisdom of the law and the actions of the heart. He wrote remarkable chapters on tafsir in Bada'i' al-Fawa'id, Al-Tibyan fi Aqsam al-Qur'an, Madarij al-Salikin and other works.
«شفاء العليل»، «التبيان في أقسام القرآن»: Shifa' al-'Alil, Al-Tibyan fi Aqsam al-Qur'an
قوبل العمل كاملًا بالجموع المطبوعة الساب: the whole work was checked against the earlier printed compilations: Daqa'iq al-Tafsir by al-Julaynd (all six parts), Tafsir Shaykh al-Islam by Iyad al-Qaysi, Bada'i' al-Tafsir by Yusri al-Sayyid Muhammad (all three volumes), and Ibn al-Qayyim's Tafsir al-Qur'an al-Karim (Dar al-Hilal). Wherever one of these compilations has words of either imam on a verse that the site lacked, the passage was traced back to his original book, and what explains the verse was added from there verbatim.
الآيات التي ليس لها بعدُ مختصر من كلام ا: verses that do not yet have a summary from the words of either imam show their meaning from al-Tafsir al-Muyassar (King Fahd Glorious Qur'an Printing Complex) in a separate box, reproduced unchanged from the Encyclopedia of the Noble Qur'an, QuranEnc.com, with its version number, to keep it distinct from the imams' words.
